description: This PHP class 'BuzzPhotoController' handles retrieving and serving Buzz photos within the OrangeHRM system. It manages caching, ETag validation, and HTTP response headers for photo content.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoController
classes.description: Controller responsible for serving Buzz photos, supporting cache validation, ETag handling, and setting HTTP headers for media responses.

methods.name: generateBuzzPhotoETagCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for storing ETag related to a specific Buzz photo ID.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main method to process HTTP requests for Buzz photos, handling cache validation and content delivery.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets standard HTTP headers for the Response object, including Content-Type and cache directives.
